question: What are the separate RNA and accessibility source-labelled cKO-minus-WT transformed-mean differences within IL4, with the within-CTRL differences as baseline context?
decision: Describe external cofactor-reference measurement patterns across complete eligible features; no exact author reproduction, interaction, original NAM mechanism or selected-target conclusion.
strongest_rival: Baseline genotype differences, compositional normalization, author feature/mapping selection and unknown preparation/litter/batch structure can explain apparent cross-assay differences.
discriminator: Separate within-IL4 and within-CTRL genotype descriptions using one common eligible feature universe per assay, all samples as deposited, actual unequal group sizes and fixed source mappings.
exposure_record: Original Nb-history/later-IAV context, published Deochand genotype outcomes, all prior DY1/E1/E2 results and feasibility are exposed. New cKO count-derived contrasts have not run. This is an exposed non-infectious external descriptive reference, not confirmation.
biological_unit: Source-reported mouse/preparation replicates within each source-labelled genotype/condition/assay; exact animal, litter and batch identifiers are unqualified. Mapped features are not biological replicates.
nesting_and_overlap: RNA WT IL4/CTRL3 each; cKO IL4 rep1,2,4 (3 libraries), CTRL4. ATAC4 in all four groups. Different genotype labels preclude identical genotype-specific animals but do not verify within-group independence or matched batches/litters. No pairing from rep labels; cross-assay/condition reuse unknown.
population_and_selection: Deposited WT and cKO IL4/CTRL groups only, exact columns bound in parameters. Common assay universe is every feature not all-zero across all four selected groups. All source rows remain in library denominators. Retain condition-specific all-zero rows and report them.
contrast: cKO minus WT mean log2(1+CPM), separately within source-labelled IL4 and CTRL, separately RNA/ATAC. No stimulus-by-genotype interaction or RNA-minus-ATAC effect-scale subtraction.
endpoint: Full-universe mean contrast, sample SDs, n and independent-Welch conditional intervals; dependent mapped-row same/opposite/zero fractions, equal-gene agreement and descriptive Spearman associations.
methods: All-source-feature CPM, offset1 only. Unequal-n Welch uses variance/n for each group and Satterthwaite df; 95% intervals are conditional on independent normal transformed observations. SE<=1e-12 is degenerate with unavailable interval. Exact author Ensembl and nearest-TSS symbol mappings; all annotated and absolute source-nearest-TSS distance<=2000bp. Independently verify 40 evenly spaced source-order features/assay/condition with scalar logarithms/statistics; verify all mapped sign partitions and Spearman using Pearson of ranks. No locus ranking.
missingness_and_exclusions: Only all-zero across all four selected groups excluded from common effect universe. No expression/variance/direction filtering. Missing cKO IL4 RNA rep3 is not imputed; Fig5c cKO n4 caption discrepancy retained. Unknown annotation version, vehicle24/25h, batch/litter/animal matching remain.
multiplicity: All conditions, assays and mappings reported without discovery p-values or FDR, equivalence claims, peak-independent intervals or selected targets.
precision_basis: Conditional independent-observation Welch 95% intervals illustrate sample variability under normality and independence; no verified population-CI, meaningful effect margin or power claim. Genotype labels alone do not certify these assumptions.
interpretation_limit: Exposed source-labelled transformed-mean genotype associations. Baseline context is not an interaction estimate. No verified causal genotype effect, exact published analysis, global absolute output, regulatory activity/mediation, post-withdrawal memory or original NAM hold resolution.
stop_rule: Stop on hash/sample/universe/identifier/verification disagreement. Preserve all degenerate/zero/opposite outcomes. No sample invention, pair matching by labels or favorable selected-feature follow-up.
amendment_reason: Owner-authorized F4 conditional genotype description from E1 counts, separately scoped from frozen WT-only E2.
